prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find and take object. If visible, move to it. Then check properties and perform task. Finally, scan area.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = PerformTask    />  <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO PerformTask
	END
